proposals.name: Camden-Frontier School Sinking Fund Millage Proposal
proposals.description:
This proposal will allow the school district to replace the building and site sinking fund millage previously approved by the electors.
Shall the limitation on the amount of taxes which may be assessed against all property in Camden-Frontier School, Hillsdale and Branch Counties, Michigan, be increased by and the board of education be authorized to levy not to exceed 3 mills ($3.00 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) for a period of 6 years, 2027 to 2032, inclusive, to replace the previously…
proposals.ballotLanguage:
This proposal will allow the school district to replace the building and site sinking fund millage previously approved by the electors.
Shall the limitation on the amount of taxes which may be assessed against all property in Camden-Frontier School, Hillsdale and Branch Counties, Michigan, be increased by and the board of education be authorized to levy not to exceed 3 mills ($3.00 on each $1,000 of taxable valuation) for a period of 6 years, 2027 to 2032, inclusive, to replace the previously approved sinking fund millage with a sinking fund millage for the construction or repair of school buildings; for school security improvements; for the acquisition or upgrading of technology; for the acquisition of student transportation vehicles; for the acquisition of parts, supplies, and equipment used for the maintenance of student transportation vehicles; for the acquisition of eligible trucks and vans used to carry parts, equipment, and personnel for or in the maintenance of school buildings; for the acquisition of parts, supplies, and equipment used to maintain such trucks and vans; and all other purposes authorized by law; the estimate of the revenue the school district will collect if the millage is approved and levied in 2027 is approximately $609,030 (this is a replacement of millage that will expire with the 2026 tax levy)?
proposals.officialTitle: CAMDEN-FRONTIER SCHOOL SINKING FUND MILLAGE PROPOSAL
proposals.yesVote: A YES vote approves a new levy of 3 mills for 6 years — this is a tax increase.
proposals.noVote: A NO vote rejects the new tax; your property tax rate stays where it is.
proposals.conservativeView: This is new taxation. Ask whether the need could be met within existing budgets, whether the millage sunsets, and who oversees how the money is spent.
proposals.progressiveView: New funding dedicated to a specific local service that supporters say current revenue cannot cover.
